reviewedContracts: API v10 remains the latest available published version. No new wire capability is introduced.
Interaction context 0 guild, 1 bot DM and 2 private channel is an optional observed field. Missing/null/unknown context fails exact policy checks. Guild ID presence is a separate observation.
Registration default_member_permissions controls Discord defaults; it is distinct from current injected application authorization.
Initial responses remain family-constrained and due within three seconds. Continuation tokens remain valid for fifteen minutes; policy execution extends neither deadline.

Autocomplete denies through an explicit empty type-8 result. Message denial is available to commands/components/modal submits. Existing responder atomically enforces compatibility, one initial slot and delivery uncertainty.
